description:
Add end-to-end regression coverage for the monetized desktop release flow.

The suite should cover, as current infrastructure allows:
- approval gating
- visual validation and review linkage
- LPBS artifact publication and promotion
- update manifest verification
- cross-platform release sanity checks

The purpose is to catch release regressions before paid desktop bundles ship.
name: desktop-release-regression-suite
title: Build The Desktop Release Regression Suite
